claim.quote: In this paper, we present the background stability of purity in the Ingot#94 NaI(Tl) detector, which was produced using the Ingot#85 purification method, along with the first annual modulation search conducted by the PICOLON experiment.

key_value_text.quote: The amplitude of the annual modulation takes a finite value. However, the observed effect arises from non-physical causes.
key_value_text.value: The amplitude of the annual modulation takes a finite value. However, the observed effect arises from non-physical causes.

name: Background stability and annual modulation test using PICOLON ultra-pure NaI(Tl) detector

summary.plain: PICOLON measured a small, very pure sodium iodide crystal for six months in the Kamioka mine, found its background stable, and made its first search for a yearly modulation. A small apparent modulation was traced to noise, not dark matter.
summary.technical: Ingot #94 (1.34 kg), 156.0 d x 1.34 kg between 2021-11-11 and 2022-05-24: background about 1.5 /d/kg/keV in 2-6 keVee, no time dependence of the radiopurity; the fitted modulation amplitude is finite but attributed to non-physical causes (noise cuts); WIMP limits derived from the six-month modulation, sensitivity only slightly approaching the DAMA/LIBRA region (Prog. Theor. Exp. Phys. 2025).

title: Background stability and annual modulation test using PICOLON ultra-pure NaI(Tl) detector
why_it_matters: The paper presents PICOLON as the only experiment to have demonstrated stable production of ultra-pure NaI(Tl) crystals of DAMA/LIBRA-level radiopurity.
